text: Mayor of The City of Aliso Viejo

Aliso Viejo is one of the greatest cities in our country, consistently ranked among the safest, with a close, welcoming community. It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve as your City Councilmember since 2022, and as your Mayor since 2026.
My accomplishments include:
Enabled Aliso Viejo to become the most financially sound city of all 34 cities in Orange County.
Enacted a unique ebike ordinance to curb unsafe and illegal riding.
Led the effort to bring safer, modernized bike lanes throughout our city.
Stopped a dense 8-story development at The Commons that would have forever changed Aliso Viejo.
Brought meetings back to council chambers for greater transparency.
Support the efforts our local Sheriff's and Fire Fighters.
Leading the effort to bring a world-class pump track to Aliso Viejo promoting healthy activities for our community

I am an Orange County native, entrepreneur, and IT professional. My wife of 24 years and I are proud to raise our two kids here in Aliso Viejo. Aliso Viejo is special, and we need to protect it. With proven, steady leadership, I will keep working to maintain and improve our quality of life. I would be honored to earn your vote this November.

text: Father/Aerospace Engineer
My name is Steven Von der Porten, and I'm running to represent District 2 on the Aliso Viejo City Council to focus on ensuring you have:
Safe Streets
Clean Water
Affordable Homes
Wildfire Mitigation
Transparency

I love this city. During the 15 years I've lived in Aliso Viejo, I got married, welcomed my daughter, and purchased my first home. I'm a father and an Aerospace Engineer, but never expected to run for office.

My family left Germany just before World War II. Those who remained did not survive. I heard firsthand how fear, division, and the failure of good people to stand together can have devastating consequences.

The challenges we face now require thoughtful problem-solving, not politics as usual. Aliso Viejo deserves leaders who listen, respect independent oversight and make decisions based on facts, evidence and sound judgement. As an engineer, I solve problems by listening to many points of view, analyzing data, and finding practical solutions. That's the approach we need and it is the approach I’ll bring to serving you.
I would be humbled if you visited my website at steven4av.com and I would be honored to earn your vote.
